title: The Penitent Saboteur's Bailout
logline: A celebrated strike veteran hires a pilot to disarm dormant sabotage code he planted in a refinery's cooling systems decades ago before it triggers a catastrophic blowout.

roles.description: Legendary former union organizer who planted hidden logic traps in refinery reactors; aged, sick, horrified by their impending detonation.
Head of ore smelting at the refinery; arrogant, dismissive of union warnings, believing modern diagnostics catch every fault.
An automated heavy patrol skiff guarding the refinery's private maintenance conduits.
The corporate mining consortium operating the massive stellar smelter.
The massive solar-grazing ore refinery processing cuprite and ferrite from local belts.
A decommissioned maintenance catwalk in the outer ring where strike equipment was buried.

public_situation: Thermal alarms flicker intermittently across the outer radiators of {role:smelter_complex}, but management insists the fluctuations are normal stellar weather.
private_truth: {role:retired_saboteur} planted a dormant logic virus in the coolant valves thirty years ago during a wage strike, and its fail-safe counter is running out.

beats.public_change: A frail old man in worker overalls waits in a station lounge, begging independent pilots to retrieve an old personal data drive.

missions.reason: He needs an outside pilot to recover a sealed strike cache from an unpressurized locker before refinery scrappers weld the hatch shut.
missions.private_fact: The drive holds the cryptographic disarm keys for three dormant explosive override scripts embedded in the primary coolant manifold.

beats.public_change: Smelter radiators vent superheated gas across the approach lanes as coolant telemetry drifts outside safety tolerances.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to scan the secondary coolant bypass relays to confirm which valves have already accepted the countdown script.
missions.private_fact: He intended the sabotage only as a temporary bargaining chip during negotiations, but his strike committee lost the strike before he could disarm it.

beats.public_change: Refinery automated defenses register the pilot's scan activity as an industrial espionage attack and scramble armed security units.

missions.reason: The automated security boat is jamming the disarm frequency and tracking the pilot's ship across the radiator exhaust plume.
missions.private_fact: The drone boat was programmed with patrol routes by the chief metallurgist to keep all independent inspectors away from the flare vents.

beats.public_change: The refinery's primary heat sink begins glowing dull orange as the countdown script prepares to purge thermal coolant reserves.

missions.reason: Deliver raw high-conductivity cuprite directly to the injection hopper to short out the logic bomb's physical actuator before detonation.
missions.private_fact: If the combine learns he planted the code, they will sue the union retirement fund into bankruptcy to cover maintenance damages.

player_choice.prompt: The logic bomb is neutralized, but the pilot holds the master drive documenting the strike committee's deliberate sabotage.

options.label: Wipe the drive and protect the old veteran's union legacy
Sell the sabotage dossier to the smelting combine for an corporate bounty
Use the proof to force the combine into funding the worker retirement clinic

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the cuprite, neutralizes the logic bomb, and wipes the strike drive.
resolutions.summary: The refinery stabilizes. {role:retired_saboteur} burns his notes in private, leaving his reputation intact while {role:smelter_complex} hums smoothly.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot flew through radiator plumes to disarm a thirty-year-old bomb ticking inside the central ore refinery.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot hands the sabotage drive over to the corporate combine.
resolutions.summary: {role:smelting_combine} reveals the historic sabotage. Historic union contracts are cancelled, worker pensions are seized, and {role:retired_saboteur} is imprisoned.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot leverages the disclosure risk to extract funding for worker medical pensions.
resolutions.summary: Fearing public disclosure of neglected safety overrides, {role:smelting_combine} secretly endows the worker clinic in exchange for destroying the cipher drive.

resolutions.reached_by: The disarm attempt fails or the countdown runs out before cuprite injection.
resolutions.summary: The secondary coolant loops vent uncontrolled. The central smelter suffers structural warping, forcing months of production shutdowns across the sector.

loose_threads.detail: The cipher card carries a strike fund engraving matching a catastrophic reactor flood from twenty-two years ago.
Raw cuprite futures on local trading boards surged forty percent the afternoon before the refinery radiators began flickering.

radio_hooks: Smelter operators dismiss glowing radiator plumes as routine thermal exhaust balancing.
Union delegates demand full diagnostic audit of solar refinery safety manifolds.
Smelter combine posts bounty for independent craft interfering with flare buoys.

voice_direction.retired_saboteur: Strained, urgent, and haunted. Cuts sentences short when discussing his youth and repeatedly refers to industrial equipment as living creatures.
voice_direction.chief_metallurgist: Aloof, precise, and condescending. Speaks with mathematical certainty and treats outside pilots as illiterate trespassers.
